description: Bulk Water Opportunities Statement Bulk water supply schemes 2020 Queensland (series on data.gov.au) is a series of datasets listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Local Government, Water and Volunteers. This data set contains the total annual volume of water available in Queensland’s bulk water supply schemes, water management areas and groundwater management areas as part of the Queensland Bulk Water Opportunities Statement 2020. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Local Government, Water and Volunteers. Its tags are 2020, bulk, bulk water, bulk water opportunities statement, drdmw. It offers 2 resource(s) in shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, xml. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by-4. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
